body: The hand axe and the seed sack are tied in one bundle with torn warning tape, stamped along its length. A paper tag with only a number on it hangs from the knot.
title: Hand axe and seed sack, the cold night

body: The deer came from a pasture that had been sprayed yesterday. Its mouth was wet with a bitter smell, and its legs shook. The driver said the creek near the rows smelled the same.
title: Grass along the shoulder
